transcript.text: To help narrow this down, could you tell me if the machine has absolutely no power (no lights or display on the panel), or do the lights work but it simply won't start? Also, please check that the door is fully closed and latched.
Lights come on but nothing happens when I press start. Door doesn't click shut, it swings back slightly open.

The fact that the door swings back open means the machine’s safety switch isn’t being triggered, so it won’t start. This is almost certainly a mechanical issue with the door catch or handle rather than an electrical fault. Please unplug the dryer first. Then check the latch on the door and the slot it clicks into for any trapped fluff or fabric. Also look closely at the plastic catch itself to see if it’s cracked or broken off. Let me know what you find.
The plastic tongue on the door has snapped off, I found the piece on the floor. If I hold the door firmly shut and press start it runs, but stops when I let go.

That suggests it: because the plastic tongue has snapped off, the door cannot latch properly to trigger the safety switch. The machine runs when you hold it shut because you are manually keeping the switch engaged, but it stops as soon as you let go because the catch is broken. To get you the right replacement part, I need the brand and model number of your tumble dryer. This is usually on a sticker inside the door frame or on the back of the machine. Please provide those details so we can identify the correct handle assembly.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
It's a Hotpoint. I don't know the model number offhand, I'll have a look inside the door recess and tell you.

[Heading: Likely cause: door handle]
You will need to replace the entire door handle assembly (the part that includes the latch/tongue) to fix this safely. Please go ahead and find the model number sticker inside the door recess or on the back of the machine. Once you have it, let me know exactly what it says so I can help you identify the correct replacement part.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
Sorry, I haven't got the model number yet. I'll go and look inside the door recess now. Is there anything else you need me to check while I'm there?

[Heading: Likely cause: door handle]
No other checks are needed at this stage. The broken plastic tongue is most likely the cause of the problem, and replacing that door handle assembly will fix it. Just take your time finding the model number sticker inside the door recess or on the back of the machine. Let me know exactly what it says when you find it.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
ok, I'll go and look inside the door recess now and come back with the model number.

[Heading: Likely cause: door handle]
Take your time. Once you have found the sticker inside the door recess or on the back of the machine, please tell me the exact model number so I can help you identify the correct replacement door handle assembly for your Hotpoint dryer.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
